HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES 
TWENTY-FOURTH LEGISLATURE, 2007 
STATE OF HAWAII 
H.B. ~ 0 . 7 q 
A BILL FOR AN ACT 
RELATING TO PROPERTY INSURANCE. 
BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF HAWAII: 
SECTION 1. Chapter 431, Hawaii Revised Statutes, is 
amended by adding a new section to article 10E to be 
appropriately designated and to read as follows: 
"S431:lOE- 
Property insurance; renewal following 
catastrophe. Every property insurance policy shall provide for 
the renewal of the policy at least once following any property 
loss or damage covered by the policy and caused by seismic wave, 
flood, fire, hurricane, earthquake, storm, volcanic activity, 
explosion, or other catastrophe." 
SECTION 2. This Act does not affect rights and duties that 
matured, penalties that were incurred, and proceedings that were 
begun, before its effective date. 
SECTION 3. New statutory material is underscored. 
SECTION 4. This Act shall take effect upon its approval.

H.B. NO. 7 
R e p o r t T i t l e : 
Property Insurance; Renewal Following Catastrophe 
D e s c r i p t i o n : 
Requires the renewal of property insurance at least once 
following the loss or damage of any covered property of the 
insured resulting from a catastrophe.
